ctaHeading: Caroline Springs carpenters are ready to build your project.
aboutText: With years of hands-on carpentry experience, Herron Carpentry is proud to serve Caroline Springs and Melbourne's western suburbs. We specialise in custom cabinetry, framing, decking, cladding, and full renovation fit-outs. From new builds to alfresco upgrades, we deliver quality craftsmanship with transparent quotes and no hidden costs. We work with homeowners, builders, property managers, and real estate agents across Melbourne.
servicesText: From custom cabinetry and new build framing to decks, pergolas, cladding, and full renovation fit-outs, Herron Carpentry delivers quality timber work across Caroline Springs and Melbourne's west.

services.title: Custom Cabinetry & Storage
services.desc: Bespoke cabinetry, built-in wardrobes, and smart storage solutions tailored to your home.

services.title: New Build Framing
services.desc: Timber and steel framing for walls, floors, roofs, and structural extensions.

services.title: Renovations & Fit-Outs
services.desc: End-to-end renovation support from planning and design through to the finishing touches.

services.title: Decks & Pergolas
services.desc: Outdoor timber decks and pergolas built to last and designed for the Australian lifestyle.

services.title: Cladding & Feature Walls
services.desc: Timber cladding, feature walls, and screening for privacy and visual appeal.

services.title: Doors, Windows & Screening
services.desc: Professional door and window installations plus timber screening for style and privacy.
